heading: `dynamic_ttl`
text:
### `dynamic_ttl` [LCAP.2.4]

A construct capability. `dynamic_ttl: true` permits `retain: <expr>` on
`emit` actions for TTL-lifecycle schemas, overriding the
schema-level TTL for a specific emission.

It switches the engine's TTL subsystem from a per-schema FIFO queue (O(1)
assert, O(expired × log n_schemas + n_schemas) tick) to a deadline min-heap
(O(log N_ttl) assert and tick). The log factor in N_ttl is the cost of the
per-emit flexibility.

With `dynamic_ttl: false`: per-schema FIFO queue; all facts of the same
schema expire in FIFO order; tick is
O(expired × log n_ttl_schemas + n_ttl_schemas) ([LDTL.6.1]).
